rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: On the CEC protocol of 21 March 2024 (87,397,569 voters took part), the CEC declares the election of the President "called for 17 March 2024" valid and deems Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin elected President of the Russian Federation with 76,277,708 votes (87.28 per cent); official publication ordered in Rossiyskaya gazeta and the CEC Vestnik. Signed E. A. Pamfilova (Chairman) and N. A. Budarina (Secretary). The page gives signing and publication dates of 21.03.2024 (posted 14:59).
rows.locator: Title, dates block, preamble, points 1-3, signature block

rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: The annex to the signed resolution ('Данные о числе голосов избирателей, полученных каждым из зарегистрированных кандидатов...') gives: Davankov Vladislav Andreyevich 3,362,484 (3.85), Putin Vladimir Vladimirovich 76,277,708 (87.28), Slutsky Leonid Eduardovich 2,795,629 (3.20), Kharitonov Nikolai Mikhailovich 3,768,470 (4.31), in per cent of the voters who took part in the voting.
rows.locator: Facsimile PDF page 3 (annex); pages 1-2 carry the resolution, signatures and seal
